عَصُوبٌ A she-camel that will not yield her milk copiously unless her thigh, (S, O,) or thighs, (A, K,) be bound with a cord: (S, A, O, K:) or unless the lower parts of her nostrils be bound with a cord, and she be then urged to rise, and not loosed until she is milked. (AZ, TA.) ―
-b2- And A woman having little flesh in her posteriors and thighs: or light in the hips, or haunches. (Kr, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
